body.x: Mocom Tech(www.mocomtech.com) introduced its VR screen "Screen Stadium" at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which runs Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

It is world's first 32:9 VR screen that can play 1~12 videos simultaneously on single screen. About 20 times brighter than other screens of this purpose, users can see the video images without the reduction of contrast.

It also displayed its non-moving virtual training system and VR game that moves without a motor, and it has gyroscope and location sensor attached. It is easy to install and low-priced, which could be a great factor to spread VR and virtual training to the public. Other products it displayed are portable VR device real porter.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
